roles.N01: Index choice and overhead; direct platform evidence, no universal engine claim.
roles.N02: Plan/estimate versus observation; direct platform evidence.
roles.N03: CTFL 4.0.1 sections 1.1/1.3/4.2, printed pages 15/17–18/39–42, PDF pages 14/16–17/38–41: scope of V&V and software case techniques; no curriculum or certification process imported.
roles.N04: SQLite write transaction and BEGIN IMMEDIATE conditions for B1/B2.
roles.N05: SQLite writer serialization and isolation conditions for B1/B2.
roles.S05: PostgreSQL constraints and engine-specific boundaries; prior qualified passage reuse.
roles.S06: PostgreSQL isolation and retry conditions; prior qualified passage reuse.
roles.S11: Generated inputs and properties, not an automatically qualified oracle.
roles.S12: Real/likely-user task observation, not AI opinion as audience evidence.
roles.S16: Evolutionary schema/application changes, bounded to receiving use.

professional_sources.selection: Direct source use and earlier bounded research synthesis; no exhaustive field survey, source-count inference or broad G.2 pack.

input_carriers: Exact supplier pattern bodies in this BASIS
structure_and_generated_result_use.captured: Documented practitioner questions, actions, first results, stops, source returns and result-use connections. ISDLC.4/.11 full bodies were additionally inspected.
structure_and_generated_result_use.not_captured: Actual human/AI ability to recover future DPF text, complete field coverage, measured economy, industrial transfer, realized architecture or actual future method results.
structure_and_generated_result_use.return: Open the exact body and source when a row omits an action-changing distinction; test future text on the named application before claiming its delivered value.
structure_and_generated_result_use.proposal_admission: DRR.md describes proposed organization for a Human architecture decision. It is usable to consider the boundaries with its gaps and limits; it does not constitute acceptance, a DPF edition or proof of effectiveness.

review.ordinary_e9_da_use: Can Albert select/redirect these boundaries without inventing the field or mistaking observations for DPF qualification?
review.omitted_question_found: The original ISDLC.4/.11 already contain the slot composition and examples. A gap claim based on their absence would be false.
review.repair: DRR.md now explicitly preserves that sufficient use and bases new boundaries on connected professional depth and independent change, with future full-text trial.
additional_repairs: Initial proposed pattern sets and result-use relations named.
Full future cross-family trial separated from six executed counterexamples.
review.limit: Author review; no independent evaluation or complete E.9.DA coordinate result claimed.

next_use: Albert considers the exact boundary proposal; substantive DPF pattern authoring follows accepted boundary and adequate original method basis.
